charts.title: K2-167 b: orbits around K2-167
charts.description: The orbits of K2-167's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-167 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ikwut-Ukwa et al. 2020 (2020AJ....160..209I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname IKWUT_UKWA_ET_AL__2020): P 9.97857 d

charts.title: K2-167 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-167 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (42, 92, 96) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 69747919, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 28 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 14-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min late; 14-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 9 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
